test_title: PYST 57: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. B is sitting to the immediate left of C. G and H are not the immediate neighbour of C. H is sitting second to the right of P. Who is sitting on the immediate left of C?
solution: Given: **Five friends P, B, C, G and H **(facing towards the center) 1) B is sitting to the immediate left of C. 2) G and H are not the immediate neighbour of C.
